blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—National University big man PJ Palacielo almost got a double-double against Adamson, but not in the usual way. In the Bulldogs’ 85-66 rout of the Soaring Falcons in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday, Palacielo showcased his passing game. The burly forward tallied 19 points and eight assists to help NU improve to a 3-2 record. Palacielo was quick to credit coach Jeff Napa and his staff for pushing him to hone his passing skills. “I trust my coaches with whatever they’re asking […]...
